title: Universal Life Insurance Contract Provisions: Issue and Placement in Force
content:
**Article 1 — Issue limits.** Each tier of Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance is issued only within its issue ages and with a face amount between the tier's smallest and largest face amounts, with a death benefit option among those the tier offers. Net premium may be allocated to the indexed account only on a tier that offers the indexed account.

**Article 2 — Conversion of term coverage.** A policy issued by conversion of an Ashgrove term policy is issued without evidence of insurability, in the term policy's underwriting class, at the insured's attained age.

**Article 3 — Placement.** The policy is placed in force when it is delivered and the initial premium has been credited. Both events are required: delivery alone, or a credited initial premium alone, does not place the policy in force.

**Article 4 — Declined or withdrawn applications.** A declined or withdrawn application has its premium refunded in full, without interest.

## Article-by-article summary

| Article | Condition | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Issue age, face amount and death benefit option all within the tier's figures | The tier may be issued |
| 1 | Indexed allocation requested on a tier without the indexed account | Net premium is not allocated to the indexed account |
| 2 | Policy issued by converting an Ashgrove term policy | No evidence of insurability; the term policy's underwriting class; attained age |
| 3 | Policy delivered and initial premium credited | Placed in force |
| 4 | Application declined or withdrawn | Premium refunded in full without interest |

## Hypothetical cases

- An Ashgrove Protection UL application asking for Option B is within the tier's options; the same request on an Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL, which offers Option A only, is not.
- An application on which $4000.00 of premium was paid and which is then withdrawn before placement has the whole $4000.00 refunded, with no interest added.
- A term policy converted into an Ashgrove Accumulation UL when the insured is aged 52 is issued at attained age 52 in the term policy's underwriting class, with no new evidence of insurability.
